name: Single tenant dominating request traffic
query: For each distinct tenant_schema span attribute value, (count of HTTP server spans carrying that tenant_schema) / (count of all HTTP server spans carrying a non-null tenant_schema attribute), over a trailing window.
threshold: > 10% of total tenant-scoped requests attributable to one tenant_schema
window: 15m (suggested starting point; tune against real traffic at apply time)
notes: tenant_schema is set as a span attribute by bind_actor_context (app/core/observability/context.py) only on tenant-scoped requests; platform-admin requests carry no tenant_schema and are excluded from the denominator. Useful for spotting a noisy-neighbor tenant or a runaway client integration before it degrades other tenants.
